Interface NearestNeighborsDigraphSupplier

All Known Implementing Classes:
DirectedToNNDigraph, UndirectedToNNDigraph
public interface NearestNeighborsDigraphSupplier
Supplies a directed weighted k-nearest-neighbor (k-NN) graph from weighted edge records.

Implementations may support either undirected or directed input edge data, but expose a common pipeline: set records, build vertex indexing, construct a raw sparse graph, restrict to an appropriate core (for example, 2-core), and then derive a k-NN digraph.

Author:
R. W. R. Darling
